description: Use this when you hold a Clickwise affiliate API key and need the programs that key is approved to promote, with link readiness and your existing link count; set include_available to add the ones you can apply to. For discovery without an account use find_affiliate_programs or list_programs. Requires your own Clickwise affiliate API key on the MCP connection (X-API-Key header or Authorization: Bearer); acts only on your account.
name: list_my_programs
title: List my programs
